title: Weighted internal ingress with session affinity, NLB->ALB failover and zero-downtime TLS rotation (Terraform module)
creator: Lena Zhou
description: Implement a reusable Terraform module for internal ingress that supports a primary NLB fronting ALBs, configurable weighted failover between ALBs/NLB-only fallback, session affinity options, robust health-check reconciliation, and zero-downtime TLS certificate rotation for Private (VPC) deployments.
motivation: Private customers require predictable cutover and certificate rotation without traffic loss
We need one module consumable by Private and Dedicated deployments to ensure consistent behavior across environments
Existing ingress modules lack health reconciliation and session-affinity toggles needed for stateful workloads
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module available at modules/internal-ingress with clear public interface
Support for NLB (TCP passthrough) + ALB (HTTP/HTTPS termination) dual-path routing
Can perform certificate rotation with zero dropped requests for HTTPS listeners
Weighted failover between primary and standby target groups controllable via variable
Health-check reconciliation loop reports and self-heals target group membership within defined SLOs
design_notes: Use NLB for TLS pass-through when customers opt to terminate externally or require mTLS to backends
Default behavior: TLS termination at ALB with ACM-managed certs when private deployment is allowed to access ACM
Provide enable_session_affinity bool to configure ALB stickiness (cookie-based) or NLB target group-level source_ip
Support both instance and ip target types; prefer ip for CNI/ENI-based deployments
Expose health_check_path and expected_codes; use active/passive checks to handle long-lived connections
implementation_tasks: Create module inputs/outputs and Terraform 1.5-compatible constructs
Add provider constraints and careful AWS resource naming for Shared VPCs
Implement health-check reconciliation using aws_lambda backed by CloudWatch Events (optional flag)
Add smoke tests to infra-testing repo and terraform examples per environment
Document migration steps for existing stacks to adopt module
infra_impacts: Creates/updates NLB, ALB, listeners, target groups, ACM certs, IAM roles for lambda reconciliation (optional)
May change target group type from instance->ip during migration which requires draining and DNS updates
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Deploy module to staging VPC with enable_reconciliation=false and test weighted failover 90/10
Stage 2: Enable reconciliation and session_affinity for canary service, monitor for 48h
Stage 3: Run cert rotation procedure on canary (listener swap technique) and validate zero-downtime
Stage 4: Gradually roll to production stacks with 10% increments using route weights
test_plan: Unit: terraform validate/plan for multiple var sets
Integration: infra-testing ingress-smoke runs that create module in ephemeral VPC and verify routing paths
Chaos: simulate unhealthy ALB target group and ensure failover weight shifts and reconciliation recovers membership
End-to-end: perform ACM cert rotate and assert no 5xx/SSL handshake failures for existing connections
progress_updates: 2026-02-21: Initial design doc drafted; decision to support both TLS pass-through and termination
2026-02-28: Prototype ALB listener swap for cert rotation completed in staging (PR #589)
2026-03-05: Security requested KMS/AWS account boundaries for private ACM usage; added to requirements
2026-03-12: Health reconciliation lambda implemented as opt-in; smoke tests passing locally
review_feedback: PM (Noah Patel): prioritize clear migration steps and downtime modeling
Design (Sofia Chen): prefer cookie stickiness default disabled — enables better autoscaling behavior
Security (Ava Martinez): must support customer-managed certs (S3/HSM) and audit logs for rotations
open_blockers: Need final sign-off from platform security on cross-account ACM access (SEC-431)
IAM role trust boundary review pending for lambda reconciliation (ENG-26410)
migration_notes: For customers on old-module: change target_group_type carefully — recommend blue/green migration by creating new target groups, registering new targets, switching listener rules, then destroying old resources
estimated_cost_implication: Typical staged deployment adds <= $150/month for optional reconciliation lambda and extra ALB when running blue-green
Document cost toggles and recommend enabling reconciliation only for services with >= 1M req/day
notes_linked_incidents: INC-2025-09-long-conn-drain: showed need for session affinity toggle and improved drain handling
